proposed.text: Under PD 1096 Sec. 603, a 4-hour fire-rated RC column must have what minimum cross-sectional dimension AND what minimum concrete cover over the main reinforcement?

options.text: 400mm column dimension with 40mm concrete cover over main bars
450mm column dimension with 50mm concrete cover over main bars
450mm column dimension with 25mm concrete cover over main bars
500mm column dimension with 40mm concrete cover over main bars

proposed.rationale: Original question was already source-correct and substantive; the prior edit (source-audited-article-batch-048) was degenerate, with 1-character garbage in 3 of 4 option text fields and a nonsensical rationale. Restored the original verbatim. Original source rationale: For a 4-hour rating, Sec. 603 requires a minimum RC column dimension of 450mm. The RC slab cover table shows 25mm for both 3-hour and 4-hour ratings — the column dimension (not increased cover) provides the additional fire resistance at the 4-hour level.
proposed.explanation: This question tests whether candidates conflate slab cover with column cover requirements. The 450mm column dimension for 4-hour rating is the critical differentiator from the 400mm 3-hour column. The 25mm cover applies to slabs (same for 3-hour and 4-hour). Column fire resistance at the highest levels is achieved primarily through mass, not cover alone.
